name: edit_metadata
root: Single constructor for metadata, forms, DCS, templates, extensions and reports. Pass operation=<name>; operation=help lists every operation and topic, and topic=parameters carries the full parameter rules. dryRun=true previews a call without applying it. Supports idempotent skip (propertyMismatch), cascade form cleanup (cascadeForms), object commands, form command-interface items, picture validation, batch operations and multi-language synonyms.

descriptions.operation: Operation name; 'help' lists operations and topics.
descriptions.ownerFqn: FQN of the owning metadata object.
descriptions.valueFqn: Referenced object FQN for reference and content operations.
descriptions.autoRecord: add_exchange_plan_content: per-item auto change registration - Deny (default) or Allow.
descriptions.use: add_common_attribute_content: Auto (default) / Use / DontUse; schema parameter Auto/Always.
descriptions.valueListAllowed: Schema parameter accepts a value list.
descriptions.subsystems: set_subsystems_order: comma-separated top-level subsystems in the wanted leading order.
descriptions.subsystem: The subsystem whose command interface or section visibility to change.
descriptions.command: The command to place or show: CommonCommand.X or an object command such as Catalog.X.Command.Y.
descriptions.group: create_object_command / set_command_placement / set_command_order: group name, token or CommandGroup.<name>.
descriptions.commands: set_command_order: JSON command FQNs; set_excluded_commands: JSON names, case-insensitive; empty clears under mode=replace.
descriptions.visible: true shows, false hides, for the visibility operations.
descriptions.role: Visibility operations: optional role FQN; sets that role's value, not the common one.
descriptions.name: Name of the new element (createObject / addObjectAttribute / ...).
descriptions.synonym: Synonym for a newly created object or field.
descriptions.properties: create_object: a JSON object of property name to value, applied in the creating transaction.
descriptions.externalConnection: create_object CommonModule: the External connection context.
descriptions.clientOrdinaryApplication: create_object CommonModule: the Client (ordinary application) context.
descriptions.serverCall: create_object CommonModule: whether server procedures are callable from the client.
descriptions.global: create_object CommonModule: the Global flag. Not an execution context on its own.
descriptions.propertyValue: Text/JSON; localized default-language text or language map.
descriptions.listMode: List operation: replace (default), add, remove, clear.
descriptions.type: Attribute-creating ops / set_object_type: String, Number, Date, Boolean, UUID, CatalogRef.X, or comma-separated.
descriptions.multiLine: Multi-line input mode for the attribute (BasicFeature.multiLine). Optional.
descriptions.fillChecking: Fill-check mode for a new field: DontCheck or ShowError.
descriptions.indexing: Index mode for a new field: DontIndex, Index or IndexWithAdditionalOrder.
descriptions.formFqn: FQN of the form for form operations.
descriptions.mode: set_excluded_commands: replace (default), add or remove. add and remove need at least one name in commands.
descriptions.itemNames: add_form_appearance_rule: form items to style, comma-separated; omitted = whole form.
descriptions.field: add/remove_form_appearance_rule: data path the condition reads.
descriptions.formType: create_form: ORDINARY or MANAGED (default MANAGED). Legacy purpose values are normalized to MANAGED.
descriptions.layout: Form layout for createForm: auto (typed defaults) / empty (manual layout) / standard.
descriptions.purpose: create_form: ItemForm / ListForm / ChoiceForm / FolderForm / RecordSetForm / RecordForm / Generic.
descriptions.setAsDefault: Set this form as the owner's default form (createForm).
descriptions.templateType: Template type for addTemplate: SpreadsheetDocument / TextDocument / BinaryData / ActiveDocument / GraphicalSchema / DataCompositionSchema / DataCompositionAppearanceTemplate / GeographicalSchema / HTMLDocument / AddIn.
descriptions.content: TextDocument / HTMLDocument body: filled on create, replaced by set_template_content, read by get_template_content.
descriptions.points: create_route_map: JSON array of route points, laid out top to bottom.
descriptions.overwrite: create_route_map: replace an existing Flowchart.scheme (default false - refuses to clobber).
descriptions.mainAddressingAttribute: set_task_addressing: the attribute that addresses the task.
descriptions.currentPerformer: set_task_addressing: SessionParameter FQN of the current performer.
descriptions.tabularSection: Tabular-section name for TS attribute ops (alias tabularSectionName).
descriptions.tabularSectionName: Tabular section name for TS operations.
descriptions.rootURL: create_http_service: root URL of the service (no leading slashes - platform rejects them). Default = '<name>'.
descriptions.reuseSessions: create_http_service: reuse HTTP sessions across requests.
descriptions.sessionMaxAge: create_http_service: session max age in seconds (optional).
descriptions.commandParameterType: create_object_command: parameter type; an unresolvable one fails the call.
descriptions.dataObjectName: add_data_set with dataSetType=Object: the object read; required there, refused otherwise.
descriptions.conditionType: add_conditional_appearance / add_appearance: comparison (default Equal); a partial condition is refused.
descriptions.conditionValue: add_conditional_appearance / add_appearance: the value the condition compares the field against.
descriptions.appearance: add_conditional_appearance / add_appearance / set_data_set_field_appearance: Name=Value pairs (TextColor, BackColor, BorderColor, Font, Format).
descriptions.urlTemplateName: create_http_service: name of the initial URLTemplate. Default 'Template1'.
descriptions.urlTemplate: create_http_service / add_url_template: URL pattern with leading slash.
descriptions.methodName: create_http_service: name of the initial Method. Default 'Get'.
descriptions.httpMethod: create_http_service / add_url_template_method: HTTP method (default GET); full list: topic=parameters.
descriptions.handler: Handler procedure: a name for the HTTP-service operations, a CommonModule.<Module>.<Method> reference for set_event_subscription.
descriptions.source: set_event_subscription: comma-separated source type FQNs; replaces the source.
descriptions.event: Platform event (set_event_subscription) or form event; Russian names accepted.
descriptions.createModule: create_http_service: write Module.bsl for the service. Default true.
descriptions.withHandlerStub: create_http_service / create_web_service: insert a stub handler procedure into Module.bsl. Default true.
descriptions.template: add_url_template: URL pattern (alias of urlTemplate for older call sites).
descriptions.operationName: create_web_service: initial Operation name (default 'Default'); add_operation_parameter: existing Operation name.
descriptions.returningValueType: add_web_service_operation: XDTO return type QName; default the XSD string; HTTP services are untyped.
descriptions.returningValueTypeNs: add_web_service_operation: namespace URI for returningValueType when given as a bare local name.
descriptions.valueType: add_operation_parameter: XDTO value type QName; default XSD namespace.
descriptions.valueTypeNs: add_operation_parameter: namespace URI for valueType when given as a bare local name.
descriptions.transferDirection: add_operation_parameter: parameter direction IN / OUT / IN_OUT. Default IN. Optional.
descriptions.description: add_predefined_item: presentation/description of the predefined item (optional).
descriptions.code: add_predefined_item: item code, a number or text by the owner's code type. Optional.
descriptions.isFolder: add_predefined_item: create the item as a group/folder (Catalog / ChartOfCharacteristicTypes only).
descriptions.accountType: add_predefined_item (ChartOfAccounts): Active / Passive / ActivePassive (RU aliases ok). Optional.
descriptions.order: add_predefined_item: display order; set_command_placement: 0-based position in group.
descriptions.baseProjectName: Source configuration project for adopt_* operations (the extension's parent base config).
descriptions.targetFqn: adopt_*: child to adopt (composed when omitted); set_role_right/restriction: object the right applies to.
descriptions.rightName: The access right on targetFqn - Read, Insert, Update, Delete, View, Edit and the rest; Russian names are accepted and normalised.
descriptions.value: set_role_right: grant (true) or revoke (false) the right on targetFqn. Default true.
descriptions.condition: set_restriction_template: RLS template; set_role_restriction: row-level condition; other role content is preserved.
descriptions.objectFqn: delete_metadata_object: object or child to remove; alias of targetFqn for adopt_*.
descriptions.childKind: Child kind for adopt_child: Form / Attribute / TabularSection / Template / Command / Dimension / Resource.
descriptions.containerFqn: remove_item, move_item: the form, alias of formFqn.
descriptions.parentPath: add_settings_group: the group to nest the new one inside, as dot-separated group names.
descriptions.reportAffectedSettings: remove_data_set / remove_data_set_field / remove_schema_parameter / remove_calculated_field / remove_total_field: list settings still referencing the removed element (default true); false omits the list. Settings are left unchanged.
descriptions.parentFqn: add_metadata_attribute: the object the attribute is added to.
descriptions.newName: rename_metadata_object: the name to give the object.
descriptions.disableIndices: rename_metadata_object: change points to leave out (from the dry run).
descriptions.maxResults: rename_metadata_object: dry-run list cap (default 20; 0 = no cap).
descriptions.scanLeftovers: rename_metadata_object: list plain-text traces left after the rename (default true).
descriptions.itemName: Form item name for set_property / add_form_event_handler (the field / table / button to act on).
descriptions.attributeName: Form attribute: column owner for add_form_attribute_column, or set_property target.
descriptions.mainTable: Dynamic-list main table FQN for add_dynamic_list_table.
descriptions.commandName: Form command: add_command_handler target, or an existing command add_button reuses.
descriptions.title: Title / caption for a new form element (field / group / button / table).
descriptions.parentName: Parent container for add_field/group/button/table/decoration (default: form root).
descriptions.elementType: Element subtype for add_field, add_group and add_decoration.
descriptions.dataPath: Data path binding for add_field / add_table.
descriptions.beforeName: For new elements, name one direct sibling in parentName (default container: form root); missing or ambiguous siblings refuse in preview and write. Omit to append.
descriptions.standardCommand: Bind an add_button to a platform stock command.
descriptions.handlerName: BSL handler procedure name for add_form_event_handler (default derived from the event / item).
descriptions.writeStub: add_form_event_handler / add_command_handler: append the procedure to the form module. Default true.
descriptions.picture: Picture reference for add_decoration elementType=Picture (StdPicture.X / CommonPicture.X).
descriptions.hyperlink: Render a Label decoration / Label field as a clickable hyperlink. Default false.
descriptions.autoGenerateColumns: add_table with dataPath: create a column per attribute.
descriptions.overwriteModel: repair_report_schema: replace a differing schema (a backup is written first).
descriptions.dryRun: Preview the operation inside a BM transaction and roll back. Default false.
descriptions.confirm: delete_metadata_object only: applies the deletion rather than returning a preview.
descriptions.cascadeForms: Removing an attribute, tabular section or column: also remove the form items bound to it.
descriptions.batch: Run several operations in one call, each in its own transaction; a bad name stops the batch before anything runs.
descriptions.stopOnError: batch only: stop at the first failing operation instead of running the rest.
descriptions.runKey: Handle to a run already going, from a previous answer that came back status=Pending.
descriptions.timeoutSeconds: How long to wait before answering status=Pending with a runKey instead of the result.
descriptions.operations: batch=true payload: a JSON array of operation objects, each {"operation":<name>, ...that op's own params}.
